summary: Added 64 Karma/Jasmine unit specs (89 total in the suite, all green, two consecutive runs) covering the riskiest logic: TutorialService's seven HTTP methods, ApiInterceptor url rewriting, and the branching in the add/details/drawer/list components. Used the repo's existing conventions (TestBed + HttpClientTestingModule as the only mocked boundary, no new runner or dependency). Line coverage measured with the repo's karma-coverage at 99.21% (126/127 lines, 94.44% branches), well above the 70% target. The baseline run had one pre-existing failure (TutorialService should be created) caused by the spec itself configuring an empty TestBed with no HttpClient provider; that spec is a test file, so it was rewritten rather than the app being changed, and the cause is reported as an analysis finding. One low-severity application defect (unencoded search term) and one medium-severity one (create form submits blank required fields) are documented by passing characterization tests marked KNOWN-DEFECT.

test_files.description: Rewritten from a broken one-line smoke test: verb/url/body for getAll, get, create, update, delete, deleteAll, findByTitle, plus empty list, 404, 400 and 500 error propagation, lazy subscription and unencoded search terms.
Url-rewriting branches: missing/present leading slash, empty url, http and uppercase HTTPS absolute urls left untouched, protocol-relative urls, method/body/header preservation.
viewMode vs edit mode, route-driven load, publish/unpublish with server-supplied and default messages, update, delete-then-navigate, and the error paths for each.
open boundary (null, undefined, id 0), state reset between ids, 404 vs 500 branches, unpublish, delete, and that failures emit neither changed nor closed.
POST body shape (published dropped), success state only after the api confirms, 400 keeps the form, blank required fields, form reset, and typing through ngModel.
Loading, populated, empty and error states; search replaces the list and clears the selection; remove-all refresh and its failure path; drawer changed event reloads the list.

findings.title: Add Tutorial posts blank title and description despite the fields being marked required
findings.description: add-tutorial.component.html marks #title and #description as `required`, but AddTutorialComponent.saveTutorial() performs no validation and the Submit button is never disabled, so clicking Submit on an untouched form sends {title: '', description: ''} to the api. The user only learns it was rejected if the backend happens to return an error, which is swallowed by console.error.
findings.test: src/app/components/add-tutorial/add-tutorial.behaviour.spec.ts :: sends an empty payload when the required fields are blank
findings.evidence: The characterization test asserts req.request.body equals {title: '', description: ''} after clicking Submit with no input. It passes, documenting the defect.

findings.title: TutorialService.findByTitle does not url-encode the search term
findings.description: findByTitle builds the url by string interpolation (`${baseUrl}?title=${title}`). A term containing '&', '=', '#' or a space is sent raw, so 'a&published=true' reaches the api as two query parameters and the title filter is silently truncated to 'a'. encodeURIComponent, or HttpParams, would fix it.
findings.test: src/app/services/tutorial.service.spec.ts :: does not encode a search term containing an ampersand
findings.evidence: The request url observed by HttpTestingController is exactly '/tutorials?title=a&published=true' — the ampersand is not escaped.

findings.title: Pre-existing failing spec: TutorialService should be created
findings.description: Before this phase, `npm run test` reported 26 specs, 1 FAILED. src/app/services/tutorial.service.spec.ts called TestBed.configureTestingModule({}) with no HttpClient provider, so injecting TutorialService threw NullInjectorError: No provider for HttpClient. This is a defect in the test, not in the application, so the spec was rewritten (test files are in scope for this agent) and the suite is now green.
findings.evidence: Baseline `npx ng test --watch=false --browsers=ChromeHeadless`: 'TOTAL: 1 FAILED, 25 SUCCESS', with NullInjectorError raised from R3Injector.hydrate.
